lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Visible grid-like arrangement of high-luminance circular pixel clusters. Columns are roughly vertical with increased spatial frequency and reduced cluster diameter in the lower-right quadrant of the visible flank compared to the mid-section.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Diffuse vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with circular high-luminance blobs, creating a lattice pattern where blobs are predominantly centered within or on the margins of the vertical bands.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A continuous linear feature oriented horizontally across the upper third of the flank, defined by a sharp vertical luminance gradient with high-intensity pixels on the dorsal edge and a low-intensity shadow on the ventral edge.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Low spatial frequency of high-luminance blobs distributed within the macro-mask of the triangular silhouette in the upper-left field of view; approximately 4 distinct spots are visible on the distal lateral surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A distinct high-luminance irregular mark is present on the leading/apex edge of the first dorsal fin silhouette. A singular low-luminance circular focal point is visible on the mid-lower lateral flank.
other_distinctive_markers: Five parallel, vertical, low-luminance linear apertures (branchial slits) are visible anterior to the primary lateral spot constellation.
